{{Quote|You want to know why Kuat would be interested? I'll tell you. It's because he just made one hell of an effort to make sure that Boba Fett was dead. Did word of that bombing raid out on the Dune Sea reach here?|[[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], to a [[Aeropteryx|Q'nithian]]|<ref name="TMA" />}}
Soon after the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the leader of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Kuat (person)|Kuat of Kuat]] arranged a '''bombing''' run on the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] to ensure the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].
